device: RTX 5060 Laptop GPU selected by scripts/chrome-gpu.mjs
scope: Visual stability diagnostic, not an FPS benchmark. World example; 1280x720; camera (415,referenceHeight+69,606). Allow streaming/LOD settling, stop simulation/wind, warm 48 temporal frames, compare eight consecutive screenshots. Right 780x720 pixels exclude HUD. Each scene is frozen during sampling; wind phase at freeze can differ between runs.
metric: Mean absolute RGB 8-bit channel difference across adjacent frames; changedFraction counts channel differences >3.
implementation: Separate history confidence in existing velocity alpha; exact flat per-instance fade/validity; resting impostor views accumulate, moving/zoomed/reset/skipped views reject conservatively.
limits: Residual subpixel, atlas and GTAO variation remains. No FPS rebenchmark, full browser suite, or other-GPU validation.
